message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: group premeditated to illegally excavate ancient tombs (cultural relics). They stole cultural relics, damaged protected sites. Crimes: illegal excavation of tombs, illegal possession of cultural relics, maybe "盗掘古墓罪" (illegal excavation of tombs) under the Criminal Law article 362? Actually Chinese law: "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal trade), "盗掘古墓、古遗址罪" (illegal excavation of ancient tombs). Also "破坏文物罪". The participants organized and carried out illegal excavation. So the crime is "盗掘古墓罪" (illegal excavation of ancient tombs) and possibly "破坏文物罪". The question: only this part of facts. It mentions they premeditated, used car, night, multiple times to dig. The act is illegal excavation of tombs, which is a crime under Article 362 of Criminal Law: "盗掘古墓、古遗址罪". Also they stole cultural relics, which may be "盗掘文物罪"? Actually "盗掘古墓、古遗址罪" includes illegal excavation and removal of cultural relics. So likely just one crime: "盗掘古墓罪". Could also be "组织、领导、参加盗掘古墓罪" but that's same.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗掘古墓罪<eoa>
